name: micro_imem
description: Microbenchmarks: instruction fetch over straight-line code footprints 1..32 KiB (cycles per instruction)
expect: MICRO CHECK OK micro_imem iterations={iterations} regions=11
units: instructions per region (cycles/iter = cycles per instruction)

region_ops.1: region overhead: call + return of an empty kernel (cycles/iter is not per-op)
region_ops.2: addi (32-bit) of a 1 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.3: addi (32-bit) of a 2 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.4: addi (32-bit) of a 3 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.5: addi (32-bit) of a 4 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.6: addi (32-bit) of a 6 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.7: addi (32-bit) of a 8 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.8: addi (32-bit) of a 12 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.9: addi (32-bit) of a 16 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.10: addi (32-bit) of a 24 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
region_ops.11: addi (32-bit) of a 32 KiB straight-line footprint, run repeatedly
